name: nexus
description: All-in-one workspace suite: HUD and session monitor, prompt enhancer, assumption review, command shield, secret masking, turn checkpoints with rollback, visual design previews, auto-verify and clean delivery.

shield.title: Command Shield
shield.description: Ask before dangerous shell commands run (recursive deletes, force pushes, dropped tables, pushes to protected branches).

protectedBranches.title: Protected branches
protectedBranches.description: Comma-separated branch names the shield guards against pushes; * matches any part (release/*).

sanitizer.title: Secret Leak Sanitizer
sanitizer.description: Mask API keys, tokens, passwords and private keys in every row before it is stored or sent to the model.

checkpoints.title: Turn checkpoints
checkpoints.description: Snapshot the project into a private shadow git repo before the first file change of each turn, so /rollback-nexus can undo the turn.

assumptionAudit.title: Assumption review
assumptionAudit.description: plan: review assumptions when a plan is presented. first-edit: also before the first file edit of each turn. off: never.

autoVerify.title: Auto lint/test
autoVerify.description: After a turn that changed files, run the project's linters and tests and send failures back to Claude to fix.

maxHealAttempts.title: Self-heal attempts
maxHealAttempts.description: How many times a failing check is sent back to Claude before giving up.

verifyTimeoutSec.title: Check timeout (seconds)
verifyTimeoutSec.description: Longest a single lint or test command may run.

quietTranscript.title: Quiet transcript
quietTranscript.description: Draw routine tool calls as one dim line and hide their raw output (errors and file edits stay visible).

executiveSummary.title: Executive summary
executiveSummary.description: Ask Claude to skip progress chatter and end each change with What Changed / Verification Status / Next Steps.

leanTalk.title: Lean talk
leanTalk.description: Terse replies to save output tokens. lite: no preamble, recaps or filler. ultra: telegraphic. off: as before. /lean-nexus switches it on the fly (the pick is remembered across sessions).

leanCode.title: Minimal code
leanCode.description: Before writing code, Claude checks: needed at all, already in the codebase, standard library, native feature, installed dependency, one line, then the minimum. Validation, security and accessibility are never cut.

designLens.title: Design Lens
designLens.description: Give Claude a tool that shows UI options as live visual cards in the browser and a pane, and sends your pick back.

devServerUrl.title: Dev server URL
devServerUrl.description: URL /preview-nexus captures. Empty: probe common localhost ports.

helperModel.title: Helper model
helperModel.description: Model used for prompt enhancement and assumption extraction.

notify.title: Done / approval alerts
notify.description: A desktop notification and a sound when a long turn finishes, and a sound when Claude needs your approval.

notifyAfterSec.title: Alert after (seconds)
notifyAfterSec.description: Only turns that ran at least this long raise the done alert.

compactGuard.title: Compaction guard
compactGuard.description: Warn at 80% context, tell compaction to keep file paths, open tasks, check results and decisions, and after it remind Claude of your last request word for word, the open tasks and CLAUDE.md.

handoff.title: Session handoff
handoff.description: Save a short summary when a session ends and show it when the next session in the project starts (/handoff-nexus).

loopGuard.title: Loop detector
loopGuard.description: When Claude repeats the same failing call, tell it to stop and change approach; warn when a turn runs very long.

maxAgents.title: Max subagents at once
maxAgents.description: Refuse new subagents past this many running at once. 0: no limit.

agentSteps.title: Agent step reports
agentSteps.description: Give subagents a step tool to report their progress (step 3/5 writing tests) to the Agents panel. Off: the panel shows what it observes only.

suggestNext.title: Next-step suggestion
suggestNext.description: After a reply, offer its first Next Step as the prompt's dim suggestion (Tab takes it).

commitHelper.title: Commit helper
commitHelper.description: After a turn that changed files, offer a Commit button and /commit-nexus with a drafted message.

theme.title: Theme
theme.description: Colors, bars and icons of the HUD and drawers. /skin-nexus switches it on the fly (the pick is remembered across sessions).

syncClaudeTheme.title: Claude Code theme follows the skin
syncClaudeTheme.description: A dark skin also moves Claude Code's own theme (/theme) to dark and latte to light, keeping daltonized; default and claude put your own theme back.

trimOutput.title: Trim noisy output
trimOutput.description: Fold the routine lines of long install, build, test and log output before Claude reads it (problems, head and tail kept); the full output is saved to a file Claude can read.

quotaGuard.title: Quota guard (%)
quotaGuard.description: When the 5-hour or weekly limit passes this share, ask before the turn goes on (once per window). 0: off.

turnFooter.title: Turn footer
turnFooter.description: A dim line under each answer: how long the turn took, tools run, files changed, context used and check results.

fallbackMode.title: Provider fallback
fallbackMode.description: In a claude-nexus session, when Claude's plan limit is hit: ask which profile to continue on, switch to the default fallback profile at once, or do nothing.

autoModel.title: Auto Model
autoModel.description: Model routing in claude-nexus sessions on the Claude route. auto: light work goes to Haiku, everyday coding to Sonnet, deep reasoning to Opus. opus/sonnet/haiku: always that model. off: requests go as Claude Code sent them. /automodel-nexus switches it on the fly.

autoModelOpus.title: Auto Model: Opus model id
autoModelOpus.description: Model id sent for the heavy tier.

autoModelSonnet.title: Auto Model: Sonnet model id
autoModelSonnet.description: Model id sent for the standard tier.

autoModelHaiku.title: Auto Model: Haiku model id
autoModelHaiku.description: Model id sent for the light tier.

autoModelMaxEscalations.title: Auto Model: max escalations per turn
autoModelMaxEscalations.description: How many tiers a turn may move up after measured failures (0 to 2).

autoModelJev.title: Auto Model: Jev classifier (optional)
autoModelJev.description: Optional. gray: when the built-in rules are unsure, ask Jev (TypeSafe) to judge how much reasoning your message needs. Only the message you typed is sent, never tool output or files, and never one that looks like it holds a key. Needs an account and a key in the environment variable named below; without a key, or on any failure, the rules decide as usual. always: ask on every turn, so each message you type is sent and every turn waits for the answer. off (default): never used.

autoModelJevUrl.title: Auto Model: Jev address
autoModelJevUrl.description: https address of the service that takes the Jev request. Its host must be api.commandcode.ai, api.typesafe.ai or one listed in NEXUS_JEV_HOSTS, which is set where claude-nexus starts, not here.

autoModelJevKeyEnv.title: Auto Model: Jev key variable
autoModelJevKeyEnv.description: Name of the variable that holds the key, read by claude-nexus when it starts, from the shell or from a .env file (see the README). Only CMD_API_KEY, TYPESAFE_API_KEY, JEV_API_KEY or a NEXUS_JEV_ name is accepted. The key itself is never a setting.

autoModelJevModel.title: Auto Model: Jev model id
autoModelJevModel.description: Model id sent to the service.

autoModelJevTimeoutMs.title: Auto Model: Jev timeout (ms)
autoModelJevTimeoutMs.description: How long to wait for Jev before the rules decide (200 to 5000).

autoModelJevMinConfidence.title: Auto Model: Jev minimum confidence
autoModelJevMinConfidence.description: Below this confidence (0 to 1), or below 0.6 probability for the chosen level, the rules decide.

autoModelPrices.title: Auto Model: prices
autoModelPrices.description: USD per million tokens as in/out per tier, for the cost estimate. Check your own price list.
